select ic.relname as name, am.amname as method, (i.indpred is not null) as partial, a.attname::text as column,
      pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, k.ord::int, true) as definition, oc.opcname::text as opclass
    from pg_index i
    join pg_class ic on ic.oid = i.indexrelid
    join pg_am am on am.oid = ic.relam
    cross join lateral unnest(i.indkey::int2[], i.indclass::oid[]) with ordinality k(attnum, opclass, ord)
    left join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = i.indrelid and a.attnum = k.attnum and k.attnum > 0
    join pg_opclass oc on oc.oid = k.opclass
    where i.indrelid = to_regclass($1) and i.indisvalid and i.indisready and k.ord <= i.indnkeyatts
    order by ic.relname, k.ord

select "id"::text as id, "events", "url", "filter", "headers", "payload", "enabled", "secret", "previous_secret",
    coalesce("previous_secret_until" > now(), false) as overlapping, "tenant_id", "owner_id" from "webhooks"."subscriptions" where "enabled"

update "webhooks"."subscriptions" set "failing_since" = coalesce("failing_since", now()),
          "enabled" = "enabled" and not ($1 or coalesce("failing_since", now()) < now() - $2::interval),
          "disabled_reason" = case
            when $3 then 'The receiver answered 410 Gone'
            when coalesce("failing_since", now()) < now() - $4::interval then 'No delivery succeeded for 3 days'
            else "disabled_reason" end
        where "id"::text = $5
update webhooks.subscriptions set failing_since = now() - interval '4 days'

update "webhooks"."subscriptions" set "failing_since" = coalesce("failing_since", now()),

            when $3 then 'The receiver answered 410 Gone'
            when coalesce("failing_since", now()) < now() - $4::interval then 'No delivery succeeded for 3 days'
            else "disabled_reason" end
        where "id"::text = $5
